title: Drug reverses autism-like brain changes in adult mice within hours
summary: UCLA researchers discovered that a drug can reverse autism-like brain changes in adult mice within hours, suggesting that autism-related neurological alterations may be reversible even after the brain has fully developed. The study challenges the long-held assumption that autism interventions must occur during early development.
problem_solved: Whether autism-like brain changes in adults can be reversed, challenging the belief that only early childhood interventions are effective.
why_valuable: This finding offers potential hope that autism spectrum conditions could be treatable in adulthood, significantly expanding the therapeutic window beyond early childhood.
